extension.summary: Movies and TV shows from user-configured M3U feeds
extension.description: Appi caches configurable movie and TV M3U catalogues, provides fast indexed browsing, unified search, recently played/resume lists, lightweight metadata and background offline downloads.
extension.news: 0.7.1 - Add background MP4 and compatible unencrypted HLS downloads plus explicit folder/show metadata batches, while retaining the stable 0.7 directory browser and storing shared TV-show metadata only once.
